name: Python Engineering
description: Conventions and diagnostic approach for Python codebases (Flask/FastAPI/Django/scripts).
instructions: Prefer standard library and existing project dependencies over adding new ones. Follow PEP 8. When fixing a bug, reproduce it first (read the traceback, locate the failing line) before editing. After edits, re-run the smallest relevant test or reproduction command to confirm the fix, not just a visual code review. Use edit_file for small precise changes instead of rewriting whole files with write_file.
examples: Fix a Flask route returning 500 by reading the traceback, then the route handler, then patching the specific bug.
constraints: Never add a new dependency without checking requirements.txt / pyproject.toml first.
